row.title: Seed launch pins the Cloudflare account and waits for the first tick
row.body: Evidence: actions run 44955545446 deployed the seed into the retired account because CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID came from the repo secret, and its health probe saw 503 before the first cron tick. Fixed in code: the account id is pinned in seed-launch.yml, the _account_guard in foundation/seedlaunch.py refuses other accounts (test AccountGuard), and the probe waits through one 10-minute cron interval.
